correctness.rationale: The same-arm configuration triangles retract equivariantly onto hub-axis attachment intervals when r≤L. The convex cross-arm cells D_ij={s+t≥r} have contractible intersections; their nerve is a union of row and column simplices and, by a second natural nerve comparison, has H1 of the crown graph K_(k,k) with its diagonal matching removed. The exact integer cycle lattice is matrices with zero diagonal/row/column sums and rank k²−3k+1. The exchange involution acts C↦−C^T, giving skew exterior-square augmentation lattice and symmetric kernel of unsigned incidence map; the parity map p_{ij}=c_ij+c_ji mod2 has kernel their sum. Its image lies in even-edge Eulerian cycles, and oriented 4-cycles on four labels lift all generators (pairwise differences of triangles), so p is surjective. The cycle-space dimension binom(k,2)−k=k(k−3)/2 gives the exact index. When r>L no hub-axis intersections remain; the distinct-arm cells are isolated contractible polygons, so H1=0. Independent parity rank/dimension reasoning checks k=3→0, k=4→2, k=5→5, k=6→9.
